attendance_settings.late_policy_hint: Applies company-wide. The first (threshold − 1) late check-ins each calendar month are a grace period — no deduction. From the threshold-th late check-in onward, that day's actual late minutes are deducted.
attendance_settings.late_cutoff_hint: Check-ins after this time are counted as late.
attendance_settings.late_threshold_hint: Example: 3 means the first 2 late check-ins each month are free; deductions start from the 3rd.
attendance_settings.timezone_hint: Timezone used for the punch date and the late cutoff when an employee has no assigned schedule. A scheduled punch always uses its own schedule timezone; this setting is the fallback for everyone else. The browser's local clock is never used.

toast.template_updated: Template updated — existing assignments keep their frozen snapshot

policy.title: Lateness & Deduction Policies
policy.subtitle: Configurable monthly thresholds. Proposals always require human review — configuration is not legal advice.
policy.readonly_note: You can review policies; editing requires the manage-lateness-policies permission.
policy.no_automatic_note: Even with automatic proposals, nothing is deducted from salary before approval and posting by an authorized person.
policy.edit_history_note: Editing bumps the version. Cases already created keep the policy snapshot they were evaluated under.
policy.field_hours_per_deduction_day: Accumulated late hours = 1 deduction day (approved rule: 8; empty = fixed days)
policy.conversion_note: When set, deduction days are derived from the month's canonical accumulated lateness (e.g. 24h → 3 days at 8h/day). Fractions and remainder are preserved — never rounded up.
policy.field_legal_basis_hint: e.g. approved internal rule reviewed by legal counsel — required before any posting
policy.legal_missing_warning: Without a recorded basis, deduction cases stay as review items and the system refuses to post them.
policy.hasHistoryUseDeactivate: This policy already has cases — deactivate it instead of deleting
policy.legalBasisRequired: Posting refused: the policy has no recorded legal basis
policy.selfDecisionNotAllowed: You cannot decide or reverse a case about your own attendance
policy.nothingToPost: Nothing to post — this case carries no monetary deduction
policy.toast_updated: Policy updated — existing cases keep their snapshot
policy.toast_no_new_cases: Evaluation complete — no new cases (re-run never duplicates)
policy.toast_posted: Deduction posted to payroll (one journal entry)
policy.toast_reversed: Posting reversed with a mirror entry

validation.name: Policy name must be at least 2 characters
validation.thresholds: At least one threshold is required
validation.thresholdMinutes: Threshold minutes must be greater than 0
validation.days: Deduction days must be greater than 0
validation.basis: “Days” needs an explicit day-wage basis — the system will not assume a meaning
validation.duplicateId: Threshold IDs must be unique within the policy
validation.noGrossOnRecord: No salary on record — filed as a review item, no amount was invented
validation.hoursPerDeductionDay: Hours per deduction day must be greater than 0 and at most 24

cases.title: Deduction Cases
cases.subtitle: Review, approve, post and reverse — every step is permission-gated and audited.
cases.subtitle_mine: Your lateness cases — you can see what was calculated about you, never decide it.
cases.evaluate_title: Evaluate an employee's month (idempotent — re-running creates no duplicates)
cases.evaluate_note: Accumulation is derived ONLY from existing attendance rows; missing days are never invented.
cases.conversion_detail: Accumulated {{hours}}h ÷ {{ratio}}h/day → {{days}} deduction day(s), remainder {{remainder}} · {{records}} source record(s)
cases.decision_note_hint: Why is this decision made? Stored in the audit trail.
cases.post_confirm_body: This creates ONE balanced journal (Dr Salaries Payable / Cr Salary Expense). Posting the same case twice is refused.
cases.reverse_note_safety: Reversal keeps the original journal and adds its mirror — history is never erased.

report.title: Monthly Lateness Report
report.subtitle: Re-derived live from attendance rows — corrections appear immediately, nothing is cached.
report.derived_note: Rows without a schedule snapshot are shown under their original cutoff basis and honestly labeled — they are never re-judged retroactively.
report.empty: No attendance data for this period.
